scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
欢迎来到荣耀之厅——英灵殿。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
请在这里安心休息。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
欢迎来到荣耀之厅——英灵殿。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
You will now end
your present life and
begin an entirely new life.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
您即将结束此生，开启全新的人生。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
There are a few things you must
do before we start. You must
first empty your mind and body.
Honor comes when you abandon
all your selfish desires...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
开始之前，您还需要做些准备。
首先，放空身心。
舍弃一切私欲，方能获得荣耀...

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
You cannot take anything with you to the next life. Your items, zeny, pets and Pushcart all have to be left behind.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
您不能带任何东西进入来世。
物品、Zeny、宠物和手推车，都必须留下。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
When you are ready
please return to me,
brave adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
勇敢的冒险者，准备好了，就回来见我。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
I see you've already
released yourself from
all worldy attachments,
{0}.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
{0}，看来您已经放下所有世俗的牵绊。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
That's an admirable attitude for an adventurer such as yourself. Honor comes when you abandon all personal desires for the sake of mankind.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
身为冒险者，能有这样的心境，令人钦佩。
为了人类舍弃一切私欲，方能获得荣耀。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Hmm... I sense that you have
some lingering attachment or
unfinished business in your
current life. Take care of that,
and bring closure to your present life.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
嗯...我感到您在此生还有放不下的牵绊，或尚未完成的事。
先去处理妥当，为这一生画上句号。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Now, let me remove all
of your present memories...
However, you will be able to
remember the most honorable
moments of this life.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
现在，让我抹去您此生的记忆...
不过，最荣耀的时刻，您仍会铭记。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
With one,
I will ask the
goddess Urd to remove
all of your present
memories.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
数到一，我将请求女神乌尔德，抹去您此生的记忆。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
With two,
I will ask the
goddess Verdandi to keep
and record the most honorable moments of your present life.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
数到二，我将请求女神薇丹蒂，保留并记录您此生最荣耀的时刻。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
With three,
I will ask the
goddess Skuld to
guide you to your
next life.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
数到三，我将请求女神丝柯尔德，引领您走向来世。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
One...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
一...

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
One...
Two......

[Valkyrie]
One...
Two......
And Three.

[Valkyrie]
Congratulations.
You are now reborn
into a brand new life.
Please take these small gifts
in preparation for your new adventures.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
恭喜。
您已经重生，开启了全新的人生。
收下这些小礼物，为新的冒险做好准备吧。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
I wish that the release the goddess Urd has granted you proves to be a blessing. I hope that the memories Verdandi has recorded will always honor you.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
愿乌尔德女神赐予您的解脱，成为一份祝福。
愿薇丹蒂记录下的记忆，永远为您带来荣耀。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
And I pray that the new life to which the goddess Skuld will guide you will be even more honorable than your last.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
我也祈愿，丝柯尔德女神引领您走向的新生，会比上一世更加荣耀。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
欢迎来到荣耀之厅——英灵殿。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Unfortunately, you have not yet been invited here. I ask you to leave immediately. Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
很遗憾，您尚未受邀来到这里，请立即离开。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Welcome to the Library of the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
I assume you have come here
to read the 'Book of Ymir.'
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
欢迎来到施瓦伊希比尔魔法学院的图书馆。
我想您是来阅读《尤米尔之书》的。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Unfortunately, the original copy of the book has been damaged over time. We currently only allow the public to view a copy of the book.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
很遗憾，这本书的原本历经岁月，已经受损。
目前，我们只开放副本供公众查阅。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Also, in order to preserve the original 'Book of Ymir,' we have decided to accept donations from people who wish to read the copy we have provided.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
为了保护《尤米尔之书》的原本，我们决定向希望阅读副本的人士募捐。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
The suggested
donation amount is
1,285,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
建议捐赠1,285,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Donate.
scripts.translation: 捐赠

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Thank you, your donation will be used for a good cause. You may
now go in and read the book.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
谢谢，您的捐款会用于有益的事业。
现在，您可以进去阅读了。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Unfortunately, you don't seem to possess enough zeny at the moment. Please check your funds and come back again.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
很遗憾，您目前的Zeny似乎不够。
请确认金额后再来。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Take your time, and
enjoy your travels.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
不必着急，祝您旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Once again, thank you for your generous donation. Feel free to read a carbon copy of the 'Book of Ymir' at your leisure.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
再次感谢您的慷慨捐赠。
您可以随时阅读《尤米尔之书》的副本。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Welcome to the Library of the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
Here, we have a countless number of books. Please take your time and look around.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
欢迎来到施瓦伊希比尔魔法学院图书馆。
这里藏书无数，请慢慢浏览。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
...The entrance to the Hall of Honor is open to anyone who has moved forward into their next life. It is there to help heroes decide what they want to do, and can lead them to anywhere in this world.
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
...荣耀之厅的大门，向所有进入新生的人敞开。
它帮助英雄们决定今后的道路，也能引领他们前往世间的任何地方。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
In the Hall of Honor, everything is prepared for heroes. It is rumored that any wish that cannot be fulfilled in our reality can be realized in the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
荣耀之厅的一切，皆为英雄而备。
传说，现实中无法实现的愿望，都能在那里实现。

scripts.text: Stop reading.
scripts.translation: 停止阅读

scripts.text: Continue reading.
scripts.translation: 继续阅读

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
.....
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
.....

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
There is a forgotten path which leads to the Hall of Honor, the closest place to the heavens. The ordinary will never discover this place...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
一条被遗忘的道路，通往最接近天界的荣耀之厅。
凡人永远无法发现那里...

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
...Therefore, ancient heroes were
always in anguish, knowing that
eventually, they were mortal and
would pass from this realm...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
...因此，古代英雄常怀忧虑，因为他们深知自己终究是凡人，难逃一死，终将离开这个世界...

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
There were no documents,
songs, or remaining folklore that had any information on life after death. However, I recently uncovered an old scroll
about Valkyrie...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
无论文献、歌谣，还是流传至今的民间传说，都没有关于死后世界的记载。
不过，我最近发现了一卷有关瓦尔基里的古老卷轴...

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
Valkyrie...
The legendary
guardian angel.
Angel of Ragnarok.
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
瓦尔基里...
传说中的守护天使。
诸神黄昏的天使。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
Adventurers of great strength
and bravery will be lead by
Valkyrie to Valhalla, the Hall
of Honor. There, they will be
given a new life.
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
力量强大、勇气过人的冒险者，将由瓦尔基里引领，前往荣耀之厅——英灵殿。
在那里，他们将获得新生。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
Reborn, they will live again as
even greater heroes that will
brighten the world. Bodies that
were exhausted will be filled
with energy...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
重生之后，他们将成为更伟大的英雄，为世界带来光明。
疲惫的身躯，也将重新充满力量...

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
And their souls will be given abilities with the heart of Ymir. However, the heart of Ymir was totally destroyed and scattered all over the world after the battle for Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
他们的灵魂，将获得尤米尔之心赋予的力量。
然而，卢恩·米德加兹之战后，尤米尔之心已被彻底摧毁，碎片散落于世界各地。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
I have found a small amount of
Ymir heart pieces over a long
long period of time. But I can't
confirm if the story of Valkyrie
and Valhalla is true just
through scientific tests.
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
经过漫长岁月，我找到了少量尤米尔之心碎片。
但仅凭科学测试，仍无法证实瓦尔基里与英灵殿的传说是否真实。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
So, I am leaving this record in hope that someone in the future
can confirm that Valkyrie and Valhalla actually exist...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
因此，我留下这份记录，希望未来有人能证实瓦尔基里和英灵殿确实存在...

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
Let the heroes live new lives
so they can protect the world
from danger. And then...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
让英雄们获得新生，守护世界免遭危难。
然后...

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
...

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
...

scripts.text:
[Teleporter]
Congratulations.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[传送员]
恭喜您。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Teleporter]
Please refrain
from touching any
of the exhibitions.
..........
scripts.translation:
[传送员]
请勿触摸任何展品。
..........

scripts.text:
[Teleporter]
Honorable one,
which place do you wish to go?
scripts.translation:
[传送员]
尊贵的勇士，您想去哪里？

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text: Morocc
scripts.translation: 梦罗克

scripts.text: Payon
scripts.translation: 斐扬

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Izlude
scripts.translation: 依斯鲁得岛

scripts.text: Al De Baran
scripts.translation: 艾尔帕兰

scripts.text: Comodo
scripts.translation: 克魔岛

scripts.text: Juno
scripts.translation: 朱诺

scripts.text:
[Teleporter]
Have a nice trip.
scripts.translation:
[传送员]
祝您旅途愉快。
